title: Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this anode system application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by copper-cored titanium conductor busbar and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for anode system geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for coppercored titanium conductor application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for coppercored titanium conductor performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar suitable for Copper-cored titanium conductor busbar?
faq.a: Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address anode system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for coppercored titanium conductor requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. coppercored titanium conductor components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for coppercored titanium conductor application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet coppercored titanium conductor specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Busbar / Conductor bar anode system components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
